questions.question: While Moses was on the mountain, the people asked Aaron to make them gods. What did Aaron tell them to bring him?
After Moses pleaded for the people who worshiped a golden calf, the LORD relented from the harm He had threatened. True or false?
When Moses stood at the camp entrance and said "Whoever is for the LORD, come to me," who gathered around him?
Moses asked the LORD to forgive the people's sin of making a gold calf. If not, what did Moses ask for himself?

answers.text: To be blotted out of God's book
To be released from leading them
To be given a new people to lead
